Open Graph share card background for a security, ai brand. dark-tech, minimal art direction, palette #0B0A0C, #141316, #FF2045, #FFFFFF, no text, no watermark, no UI chrome. Simple, high contrast, centre kept visually quiet so a logo and title can be composited on top.

constraints: No purple-to-blue gradient on a white card unless the reference design actually uses one.
No emoji as icons. Use a real icon set or draw inline SVG.
Body text is never below 15px, and never pure #000 on pure #FFF.
Every section must differ from its neighbour in background, rhythm or column count - eleven identical centred slabs is the single clearest tell of a generated page.
Buttons need real hover, focus-visible and active states, not just a colour change.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: hold transforms, keep opacity fades.
Images need explicit width/height or aspect-ratio so nothing shifts on load.
Ship real copy, not lorem ipsum, and not three-word headlines that say nothing.
On dark, raise surfaces with a lighter background plus a 1px translucent border - a drop shadow is invisible on black and does nothing.
source_description:
My role. UI UX design, product design, design system

Project description.

Siegepal is an AI cybersecurity SaaS platform: autonomous AI agents that run reconnaissance, vulnerability scanning, cloud posture checks, MITRE ATT&CK mapping and report generation for security teams. The capture set is a dark-tech product UI (near-black ground, crimson accent, thin white-8% strokes, 12-16px radius cards, Gilroy display + Helvetica body) covering a marketing hero plus the full logged-in app shell.

Screens in the mosaics:
- Marketing hero: top nav (Home, Agents, Pricing, Contact, Docs, "Start Free"), huge two-line display headline "Autonomous AI Agents for Cybersecurity", stat pills (13 AI Agents, 30+ Integrations), a floating terminal card streaming agent log lines ([Agent: Reconnaissance] Scanning target... Found 47 subdomains... Detected 12 critical vulnerabilities), primary pill CTA with crimson gradient edge and a video button; mobile hero with ring-stat cluster (1B+ vulnerabilities found, 10M+ scans, 99.9% uptime, 500+ security teams).
- App shell: left sidebar with logo, collapse chevron, nav items Dashboard, Agents, Chat, Cloud Inventory, MITRE ATT&CK, Tools, Reports, Settings (active item = crimson gradient fade pill); top-right bell + avatar buttons.
- Dashboard: "Welcome back, Mihai" + subtitle, 4-up KPI row (Active Agents 8 +3%, Vulnerabilities 42 +12%, Scans 23 +5%, Compliance Score 93% +3%) each a card with big number, label and green delta; "Recent Activities" table (Time, Agent, Action, Status with coloured status text) with "View all" link; action row: primary gradient pill "Start New Scan" left, white pills "View All Reports" and "Configure Agents" right.
- Cloud Inventory: title + subtitle, 4-up KPI row (Total Resources, Active Resources, Recently Deleted, Security Events), "Resource Inventory" with segmented control (List view / Graph view / Security events) and CSP dropdown, bar chart "Resources by Type", donut "CSP Distribution" with legend, full-width line chart "Resource Trends".
- Settings & Configuration with a centered 3-step modal "Connect AWS Account" (stepper, Step 2 Enter Credentials: two-column form fields, region select, toggle "Scan all regions", crimson security note box, Back (white) / Next (gradient) buttons).
- AI Agent Chat: title + subtitle, chat panel with user bubbles right-aligned and agent bubbles left with avatar, composer "Ask AI Agents to perform security tasks" with send button; right rail: "Active Agents" two cards with status dot, "Command Execution Log" timestamped list, "Live Discoveries" cards (Misconfiguration / Vulnerability / Policy Issue with High/Medium/Low severity chips).
- MITRE ATT&CK Framework: search field, Load Template (white) / Export (gradient) buttons, view tabs (Matrix, List, Flow, Heat Map), legend (Rare/Moderate/Common/Critical/Selected), tactic columns (Initial Access, Execution, Persistence) with technique tiles coloured by frequency.
- Reports: title, "Ask AI to generate reports" search, 4 KPI tiles (Total Reports, Scheduled, Generated This Week, Pending Review) with New Report / Schedule / Export buttons, "Report Templates" filter tabs (All, Security, Compliance, Custom) and a 3x2 grid of template cards (icon, name, category chip, description, sections/agents/time/coverage meta, progress bar, Generate button + preview/settings icon buttons), "Recent Reports" list rows (icon, title, generated-by meta, status + format chips, row actions), "Scheduled Reports" toggles, "AI Report Assistant" panel with suggestion chips and "Generate with AI" button.
- Auth: split "Create Account" screen (left hero image + trial benefits checklist + trust badges, right glass form with Google/GitHub buttons, email form, gradient CTA).
- Style guide pages: colors (strokes: white 8%, crimson gradient #FF2045, #F54562), fonts (Gilroy Bold 72/52, Medium 40/28/16; Helvetica Regular 16/14/12), 81 icons, sidebar states.

Skills and deliverables

UX & UI
Dashboard design
Design system
Dark mode SaaS
Security product UI
